subject.title: Feature Request: Token Usage API for session_status Tool

question: Should OpenClaw expose raw token, cost, quota-window, and freshness/source metadata through `session_status.details.usage`, or should this become a separate agent-facing usage tool/API?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the stable response shape, privacy boundary, quota-window semantics, and freshness/source model are public API and product choices rather than a narrow bug repair.

options.title: Extend `session_status.details`
options.body: Add a stable `details.usage` object while preserving current rendered status text and session visibility checks.

options.title: Create a separate usage tool
options.body: Keep `session_status` display-oriented and add a narrower agent-facing usage query surface backed by existing gateway/transcript usage code.

options.title: Keep raw usage out of tools
options.body: Document that agents should use existing display/gateway/UI surfaces and not consume raw usage through `session_status`.

recommendation.title: Extend `session_status.details`
recommendation.body: Add a stable `details.usage` object while preserving current rendered status text and session visibility checks.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the tool, maintained adjacent usage/status behavior, and already framed the unresolved API/product decision in the prior review.
